lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Media and news (headline, source, reliable, fake news, bias, coverage, breaking news, rumour, viral, censorship).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: The headline says the mayor has resigned.
Always check the source of a story.
This newspaper is a reliable source.
Fake news spreads quickly on social media.
Some channels show a clear political bias.
The coverage of the election was excellent.
We interrupt this programme for breaking news.
It's only a rumour. Nobody has confirmed it.
The press was waiting outside the court.
I read an interesting article about housing.

items: **publish / break / cover** a story; **report on** an event
**a news story**, **a piece of news** (news é incontável)
**the front page**, **a newspaper column**, **a TV broadcast**
"The news are bad today." **News** é incontável e singular: **The news is bad today.**
"I saw a news on TV." Use **a piece of news** ou **a news story**: **I saw a news story on TV.**
"The jornalist wrote a materia." Em inglês: **The journalist wrote an article.**
"Fake news" não leva -s e é incontável: **There is a lot of fake news.**

The video went ___ and millions of people saw it.
It's only a ___. Nobody has confirmed it.
Some channels have a clear political ___.
The news are bad today.
acc: The news is bad today

exercises.prompt: I saw a news on TV yesterday.
acc: I saw a news story on TV yesterday
I saw a piece of news on TV yesterday
I saw some news on TV yesterday

exercises.prompt: The journalist wrote a materia about housing.
acc: The journalist wrote an article about housing

lessons.title: Inversão para dar ênfase
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: inversão depois de expressões negativas e restritivas (never, rarely, hardly, no sooner, not only, only after, under no circumstances).

head: Expressão
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: Never have I seen such a biased report.
Not only did he lie, but he also refused to apologise.
Hardly had the news started when the power went off.
No sooner + had + sujeito + particípio ... than
No sooner had she left than the phone rang.
Only after the story was published did we learn the truth.
Little did they know that the story was false.
Under no circumstances should you share unverified news.

items: A inversão é **formal e enfática**. Aparece em textos, discursos e notícias, e não em toda conversa.
Na inversão o auxiliar vem **antes do sujeito**, como em pergunta. Se não há auxiliar, use **do / does / did**: *Rarely do we see this.*
**Hardly / no sooner** pedem **past perfect** na primeira parte: *Hardly had I sat down when...*
"Never I have seen this." O certo é **Never have I seen this.**
"Not only he is late, but he is rude." O certo é **Not only is he late, but he is also rude.**
"No sooner she arrived than it started raining." O certo é **No sooner had she arrived than...**
"Rarely we see good news." O certo é **Rarely do we see good news.**

exercises.prompt: Never ___ I seen such a biased report.
Not only ___ he lie, but he also refused to apologise.
No sooner ___ she left than the phone rang.
Rarely ___ we see good news on the front page.
Never I have seen this before.
acc: Never have I seen this before

exercises.prompt: Not only he is late, but he is also rude.
acc: Not only is he late, but he is also rude
Not only is he late, but he's also rude
Not only is he late, but he has also rude

exercises.prompt: No sooner she arrived than it started raining.
acc: No sooner had she arrived than it started raining

lessons.title: Inglês prático, discordar com educação
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Discordar com educação.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I see your point, but... / I take your point; however...
I'm afraid I don't quite agree. / I'm not sure that's entirely true.
That's one way of looking at it, but... / Have you considered...?
Where did you read that? / Do you have a source for that?
With respect, I think the evidence shows otherwise.
Let's agree to disagree. / We may see this differently, and that's fine.

items: "I'm not agree with you." O certo é **I don't agree with you.**
"No, you are wrong!" é direto demais. Prefira **I'm afraid I see it differently.**
"I disagree of you." O certo é **I disagree with you.**

exercises.prompt: I see your ___, but I disagree.
I'm ___ I don't quite agree.
That's one ___ of looking at it.
Let's agree to ___.
I'm not agree with you.
acc: I don't agree with you
I do not agree with you

acc: I disagree with you
